scope: Adapter integration unit/fault review; actual observations supplied by root separately

cases.requires: Exact global sequence/context survives rotation; active segment sync precedes observable wire callback; default cold bytes do not self-attest commit
Short/throw/unknown send, fsync and seal faults retain admitted prefix, fence future writes and authority, do not fabricate SENT
Background/foreign boot or generation/stale clock/sink failure cannot dispatch; repeat close stable; restart has no restored grant
Expected AP/model/config/hash/endpoint and current observed identity must agree; metadata supplied by caller remains labelled structural
Each admitted AP frame is contiguous with exact received bytes; wrong peer/rate/duplicate/truncated RX fails; full record and INTENT fsync before sensor callback
Real observer serialized with frame groups, <=250ms freshness and bounded pending state; wrong nonce/peer/boot and stale calibration never refresh valid state
New pinned artifact and format; exact global event ranges/stages; bounded producer publication plus durable drain; no unread overwrite, sampling or flush-after-exit assumption
Independent current-format receivers reject missing/reordered/tampered/context-mismatched segments, retain incomplete as unknown; external anchors not inferred from package
20GiB entry,10GiB+256MiB floor/15sforecast and declared run/copies/export budget; zero diskfill or guard weakening
Precise executable/source/input allowlist and observed APK/AP/tool/process/probe identity; no broad wildcard or silent regression-provider substitution
Root observed Android-source telemetry/provider/journal/clock/lifecycle and cold closed raw, preserving local-send versus AP-execution distinction
Manual/assisted/neutral takeover, link/AP reboot and30min fullframes1x/500mscap on selected native externalcandidate; immutable elapsed and all owned resource closures
